creator: Codex-assisted deterministic procedural pixel-art builder
rights: Original project working material generated from repository-authored character descriptions; no third-party ZIP, external image, or game artwork used.
prompt: Create original top-down pixel movement cycles for Nora Bellweather (adult, midlife, elder) and Tavi Bellweather (toddler, child, teen, young adult). Preserve Nora's short indigo bob, rose overshirt, cream ring and wide-leg trousers, with silver hair/posture progression and a cane only for elder. Preserve Tavi's purple cap, leaf-green overalls, violet boots and kite-spool identity cue; scale the cap and garments with growth, omit adult-coded accessories, and keep all poses fully clothed and age-safe. For every stage produce four cardinal directions and four visibly distinct gait phases plus neutral idle and friendly non-romantic interact. Transparent 24x32 RGBA, common feet pivot (12,31), crisp limited-palette pixel clusters, no text/logos/shadow/3D or copied art.
limitations: Concept sprites require artist review and animation playback review.
Age readability and pivot/collision fit require human review.
Catalog mappings are references only; not integrated with runtime loading.
